requirements: Meet WCAG 2.1 AA perceivable, operable, understandable and robust criteria
Prefer semantic HTML and Radix primitives over div-only controls
Maintain logical focus order and a visible focus-visible ring (the shadcn default is ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-2)
Associate a label with every form control; group related fields with fieldset/legend
Dialogs, sheets and drawers must trap focus, close on Escape, and return focus to the trigger
Announce dynamic updates with an appropriate aria-live politeness level
Use table semantics with caption, th and scope for data tables
Provide a skip link when navigation is repetitive
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for every transition and animation

contrastMinimums.focusIndicator: 3:1 against both the component and the adjacent background

radixNote: Radix primitives supply roles, ARIA wiring and focus management. Do not re-implement them by hand or override role attributes on a Radix part.

requirements: AI-generated regions must be programmatically identifiable, not styled-only
Streaming or in-progress output must announce start and completion via aria-live=polite
A loading or thinking indicator must expose accessible status text, never animation alone
Confidence and risk signals must carry a text label, not color or iconography alone
